title: Phased Elasticity Rollout and Sampled Utilization Harness
author: Priya Desai
description: Background: fleet autoscaling at high churn leads to noisy utilization signals and unstable burst behavior for Dedicated pools. Motivation: ship a low-risk rollout path for a new phased elasticity controller that smooths burst windows and uses sampled utilization telemetry to avoid noisy triggers. This PR introduces a phased rollout controller (elasticity.rollout_phase) and a sampled-utilization-harness that emits lightweight sampled telemetry to the provisioner to make incremental scaling decisions. Changes: 1) controller: add PhasedElasticController with three phases (observe-only, conservative-actuate, adaptive-actuate) and a configurable phase duration and success criteria. 2) metrics: add sampled_util_percentiles (p50,p90) and util_sma_1m/5m to the telemetry fanout with a small memory footprint. 3) policy: introduce elasticity.policy v2 which supports soft_reservation_windows, burst_smoothing_alpha and min_window_ms to cap oscillations. 4) rollout: implement canary targets metadata so the controller can target pools by tag and ramp phases deterministically. 5) safety: introduce an emergency-decay-backstop that enforces conservative scale-down when tail latency or error rates cross thresholds. 6) observability: dashboards and alerts for phase transition success rates, sampled-util drift, and burst_smoothing impact. Migration: new controller is opt-in via cluster config: "elasticity.rollout_phase": "observe-only", and can be promoted to conservative/adaptive after CanarySuccess metrics are met. Performance: sampled telemetry reduces cardinality by 12x for large fleets compared to full-emit while retaining actionable signals for p90-based burst decisions. Testing: unit, integration, and simulated-fleet acceptance tests included. Rollout plan: 1) deploy observe-only to 2 Canary pools for 24h, verify no actuations and that sampled-util correlates with full metrics (correlation >0.95 on p50/p90). 2) promote to conservative-actuate on 10% of pools for 48h, monitor tail latency and canary success gates. 3) if gates pass, enable adaptive-actuate on staggered groups (25% -> 50% -> 100%) with 6h stabilization windows and automatic rollback on RegressionAlert. Impact: improves utilization stability during microbursts and reduces unnecessary scale churn, while preserving throughput guarantees via soft reservations. See Linear ENG-3124 for experiment dashboards and thresholds. Breaking changes: none by default; new policy is backward-compatible and behind feature flag. Checklist: [x] controller implementation [x] sampled telemetry emitter [x] policy schema updates [x] unit + integration tests [x] docs and dashboard panels [x] rollout gating in operator config

release_notes: Introduce phased elasticity controller and sampled utilization harness. Opt-in rollout via operator config with three phases: observe-only, conservative-actuate, adaptive-actuate. New policy v2 supports soft reservation windows and burst smoothing to reduce churn. Sampled telemetry lowers metric cardinality for scaling decisions. No breaking changes by default.
